def install_root_finite_words(owner_scope, record, runner):
    preparation_directory = runner/"request231-source-preparation"
    require(not preparation_directory.is_symlink(),
            "Actual source-preparation directory is not a symlink")
    preparation_file = preparation_directory/"source-views.json"
    preparation_receipt = identity(preparation_file)
    checked(preparation_receipt, runner)
    preparation = json.loads(preparation_file.read_bytes())
    require(preparation.get("schema") == "R547-root-cached-current-owner-projected-model-source-preparation-v1"
            and preparation.get("request_number") == 231
            and preparation.get("run") == {key:os.environ.get(key) for key in RUN_KEYS}
            and preparation.get("complete") is True,
            "Complete same-job original-chain and R535 source preparation")
    require(preparation.get("actual_computations") == str(HERE)
            and any(row.get("role") == "owner" and row.get("actual") == identity(__file__)
                    for row in preparation.get("generated", [])),
            "The actual installed current owner belongs to the complete source receipt")
    child = preparation.get("R535_child")
    require(isinstance(child, dict) and child.get("returned") is True
            and child.get("actual_exit") == 0,
            "Actual R535 source-only child returned successfully")
    binding_file = checked(child["actual_source_receipt"], runner)
    require(binding_file == preparation_directory/"R535"/"source-binding.json",
            "The independent actual R535 source-binding path")
    binding = json.loads(binding_file.read_bytes())
    require(binding == child.get("source_result"),
            "The complete source binding agrees with the actual preparation receipt")
    record["root_finite_word_cache_source_preparation"] = preparation_receipt
    record["root_finite_word_cache_source_binding"] = dict(
        actual_file=identity(binding_file), actual_binding=binding)
    adapter_file = HERE/"root_20261116_native_root_finite_words.py"
    require(not adapter_file.is_symlink() and adapter_file.stat().st_size == 10892
            and file_sha(adapter_file) == "1c99623e2cd63d0a4700011c96e5054645cf7dd8ee5cf3357f0c77d1727026db",
            "The exact published R535 compiler adapter")
    module_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("_R547_actual_root_word_compiler", adapter_file)
    adapter = importlib.util.module_from_spec(module_spec)
    sys.modules[module_spec.name] = adapter
    module_spec.loader.exec_module(adapter)
    record["root_finite_word_cache_compiler_installation"] = adapter.install_owner_compiler(
        owner_scope, binding)
    return record["root_finite_word_cache_compiler_installation"]
